model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the comparison between the effect of different language models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-L2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2) on various Indo-European (IE) language families (Baltic, Germanic, Indic, Romance, Slavic, other), along with the isolate and semantic classifications. The horizontal axis represents the IE language families and other classifications, while the vertical axis measures the effect, scaled from 0 to 30. Each language model is represented by a distinct color: mBERT-L2 in blue, XLM-L2 in green, mBERT-R2 in red, XLM-R2 in light blue, mBERT-B2 in pink, and XLM-B2 in orange. The chart includes error bars indicating variability or uncertainty in the measured effect. Some bars are notably taller, suggesting a larger effect for those language model and IE language family combinations, while others are significantly shorter, indicating a lesser impact. The chart does not sort the bars in any specific order nor does it visually emphasize any particular bar or group of bars.
